text:
jamal: Quick follow-up from yesterday's authz outage — I'm compiling action items & owners. Please ack and confirm timelines by EOD Fri.

maria: Thanks. Observed recurring pattern: refresh token validation errors + stale permission cache misses. I'll paste the query and a Grafana link in a sec. :mag:

alex: I can take hardening of the token validation path. Plan: add strict schema checks, tighten clock-skew allowance, and surface validation failures to Sentry. Target full rollout: 2026-04-05. Jira: INF-2481.

katie: I'll own the audit-logging gaps we saw — add request_id / user_id to authz logs and ship enriched logs to long-term S3. Quick spike in 48h, full rollout by 2026-04-12. Ticket: SEC-612.

maria: Query I'm running (copy/paste):
```sql
SELECT err_code, count(*) AS hits
FROM token_events
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY err_code
ORDER BY hits DESC;
```
Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood/incidents/token-validations :link:

alex: :thumbsup: Also adding a synthetic canary that exercises refresh & permission-check path every 5m. Canary will push metrics to the auth-service namespace.

jamal: Owner matrix so far: Alex -> INF-2481 (token validation hardening + canary), Katie -> SEC-612 (audit logging + log schema), Maria -> INF-2482 (alerts + queries). I'll take INF-2490 (update secrets rotation runbook + post-incident checklist).

security-bot: Rotation reminder — scheduled window 2026-04-10 02:00 UTC. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/rotations. Please ensure key owners have acknowledged.

maria: One follow-up question: why were temporary tokens not invalidated after permission revokes? My hypothesis: cache TTL on permissions table vs session TTL mismatch.

alex: I agree. I'll instrument cache hit/miss and TTL distribution and add an alert when TTL > 30s. New ticket INF-2483.

katie: Also proposing a nightly permission-audit job that compares active sessions with current ACLs and writes a report to S3; we can use that for automated rollbacks if drift is detected.

jamal: OK — action items captured. Everyone please comment on their Jira ticket with an initial plan by EOD Fri and ping me if you need help. We'll reconvene Mon 10:00am in incidents sync to review progress. :calendar:

alex: Quick snippet I'll add to the canary runbook:
```bash
# call refresh endpoint and assert user perms
curl -s -X POST https://auth.redwood/internal/refresh -d '{"user":"canary","token":"$CANARY_TOKEN"}' | jq '.permissions'
```

katie: Noted. I'll draft the log schema and post in this thread when done.

jamal: Thanks all — marking this thread for follow-up. If anything blocks, escalate in #eng-oncall. :eyes:
